raw_packet.full_request:
덕테이프 포스터로 동네 생활수리 워크숍을 홍보해줘. SNS와 지역 커뮤니티에 올릴 16:9 가로 포스터 다섯 장이 필요해. 다섯 장은 전체 스타일과 구도가 서로 달랐으면 좋겠어. 의자나 옷을 함께 고치는 경험이 시각적으로 느껴져야 하고, 설명부터 일정·장소·비용·신청 안내까지 자연스럽게 읽히게 해줘. 본문을 작게 구석에 밀어 넣지 말아줘. 단색 바탕의 큰 고딕 제목·정보 블록에 작은 그림만 붙인 구성, 빈 방을 글자판으로 쓴 구성은 제외해줘. 로고·QR·새 문구 없이 아래 문구를 각 한 번씩 정확히 넣어줘.

고쳐 쓰는 토요일

헐거워진 의자와 찢어진 옷을 가져오세요. 이웃 수리자와 도구를 나누며 다시 쓰는 방법을 배웁니다.

Packet source_assets and protected_layouts are both empty: zero source-image opens and zero protected-layout reads are applicable. Actually opened and visually inspected all 15 exact poster assets with tools.view_image(detail:'original'), emitting each result: M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M4 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M5 native, usage720, thumbnail320. Completed that sequence before beginning the first copy transcription, judgment or score. Retained first reads in session memory. Subsequently made one exact pinned native revisit for M2 invitation spacing and one for M3 invitation spacing; both initial readings are preserved. Actual poster opens: 15 initial plus these 2 explained revisits. Usage PNGs are 720x405 and thumbnail PNGs 320x180, inspected at their supplied sizes; no crops, replacement images or image edits. Session identity is not invented; session_id is null. Hash/header checks and helper success are not claimed as visual opens.

content_form.location: macro wood and denim surrounding central type
content_form.observation: Material detail and oversized type dominate, while the cooperative action is confined to the lower-left inset. The workshop theme is identifiable but the visual proposition is closer to a generic repair collage than a distinct shared-experience concept.

hierarchy.location: two oversized title lines and lower blocks
hierarchy.observation: Korean and English titles both demand very strong emphasis, followed by a much smaller workshop name but another strongly enlarged date. The relative weights overstate the titles and date compared with the full explanation.

typography.location: navy Gothic title, slogan, date and support
typography.observation: Almost every role uses emphatic navy Gothic weight; oversized English and the large date compete with the Korean title. The copy is faithful and readable, but role differentiation is blunt rather than refined.

space.location: angular cream panel and right invitation line
space.observation: Irregular photo edges make the headline and support panel broad at the top and cramped at the lower right. The invitation approaches the edge and the divided footer reuses a stock information grouping despite the new silhouette.

image_material.location: chair joint and denim stitch macros
image_material.observation: Wood grain, chipped finish, screw head and denim fibers have clear, coherent detail. The chair repair inset retains recognizable contact between screwdriver, joint and supporting hands.

emotion_control.location: wood/denim macros versus small hands inset
emotion_control.observation: The image reads primarily as emphatic material repair. Human sharing receives less visual emphasis, giving the invitation a more promotional, less communal feeling than M1/M3/M4.

ai_slop.location: stitched denim, wood joint and angular collage seams
ai_slop.observation: The macro details are internally legible and the white cutout seams form an intentional collage boundary. No visible pseudo-label, gratuitous icon or contradictory extra print appears.

residuals: Native ratio fails the predeclared 16:9 tolerance even though both supplied downsampled views are 16:9.
Heavy title/English/date typography and a tight lower-right edge reduce refinement.
Macro textures dominate the shared repair action, which is concentrated in the lower-left inset.
The angular photo surround still encloses the same title/body and two-column logistics structure used elsewhere in the set.

evidence.location: top photo triptych and white lower half
evidence.observation: M1 is the clearest band-based variation: three action photographs over a centered title/slogan/body and divided event/application footer. The lower information anatomy persists in the other members.

evidence.location: central paper with activity at both edges
evidence.observation: M2 wraps photographic repair around a centered title, subtitle, slogan and paragraph, then event-left/application-right surfaces. Its full reading route closely matches the painted M3 and angular photographic M5.

evidence.location: yellow table text area with people and cloth around it
evidence.observation: Compared with M2, the palette, paint and visible tool exchange change, but the central typographic stack and divided lower logistics are nearly the same. A changed medium does not produce a new whole system.

evidence.location: large left chair, top process row and center-right brush title
evidence.observation: M4 adds asymmetry, a process montage and brush/serif roles, making a meaningful variation from M1/M2/M3. Yet the title/slogan/body and lower event/application division remain, so this one variation does not make all five systems distinct.

evidence.location: wood/denim surround and central angular panel
evidence.observation: M5 uses macro crops and an angular silhouette, but it again places large titles above explanation and two lower information columns. It is close to M2/M3 organization despite different crops and support weights.

residuals: Five single opaque posters are present, but the set mainly changes scene treatment, palette, crop and some headline handling over a recurring title/slogan/body/divided-logistics route.
M2, M3 and M5 are especially close in central organization; M1 and M4 offer real variations without establishing five distinct complete visual systems.
